bmp3_rok.name: BMP-3 (ROK)
bmp3_rok.authority: The owner, 2026-11-01: "now update the ... bmp 3 rok, bwp-1 ...". Release 268 (item/italy-korea-bmp-267) rebuilt it as the BMP-3 in Republic of Korea Army service on the fleet's own BMP-3 hull (profiles/afvFamily.ts buildBMP3Hull, shared with bmp3) under its existing ROK turret, from photographs, with no 3D model to follow; it won its blind A/B against the previous build 2-0 (Opus high, Sonnet high, round bmpr2). Stage A's photo route through this packet is proposed to Main in the 268 READY. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified: no owner model exists for this configuration.
bmp3_rok.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule). Width over the fender ledges (the published BMP-3's 3.15 m). Length from the stern to the 2A70's muzzle with the gun forward (the published 7.14 m hull). Tallest is the tip of the longer whip antenna; the body stands 2.80 m at the sight drum. The spec's calibre is the 30 mm 2A72, the game's main weapon; the drawn 100 mm 2A70 shares the mantlet. The ROK Army photograph (3rd Armoured Brigade) is the followed vehicle; the Russian BMP-3 photographs give the views it lacks.

bwp1.name: BWP-1 (RCWS-30)
bwp1.authority: The owner, 2026-11-01: "now update the ... bmp 3 rok, bwp-1 ...". Release 268 (item/italy-korea-bmp-267) rebuilt it as the Polish BWP-1 modernisation demonstrator carrying the Rafael RCWS-30 unmanned station (MSPO 2004), on the fleet's BMP-1/BMP-2 boat hull (profiles/bmpBoatHull.ts, shared with bmp2) with the station of profiles/bwp1Rcws30.ts, from photographs, with no 3D model to follow; it won its blind A/B against the previous build 2-0 (Opus high, Sonnet high, round bmpr2). Stage A's photo route through this packet is proposed to Main in the 268 READY. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified: no owner model exists for this configuration.
bwp1.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule). Width over the bolted appliqué on the fender bins (the published BMP-1's 2.94 m is over the hull). Length from the stern doors to the bow with the 30 mm traversed forward (the published BMP-1's 6.74 m). Tallest is the tip of the whip antenna; the station's sight head stands 2.60 m. The RCWS-30 is unmanned: the gunner sits in the hull (internalLayoutRegistry.ts bwp1Rcws30), and the station carries one Spike-LR canister on its side arm.
